overview: A mobile-first, iOS-style landing page for The Smart Cloud, a decentralized sovereign cloud infrastructure initiative, featuring ecosystem cards, founder profile, and core technical pillars.
features: Mobile-first iOS-style card layout with frosted glass effects
Hero section with cloud logo and live-status badge
Interactive ecosystem cards linking to OpenAgentOS and Global Compute Reserve
Founder profile card with LinkedIn and X/Twitter links
Core pillars bento grid highlighting technical advantages
